d: We are seeking a responsible and service-oriented professional to support fresh food delivery operations and store coordination. The role focuses on managing daily delivery activities, coordinating with suppliers and retail stores, monitoring product quality and inventory, and ensuring timely and efficient distribution of fresh food products. The successful candidate will help strengthen store relationships and maintain smooth supply chain operations.
Coordinate daily fresh food delivery schedules, order processing, and distribution activities.
Liaise with retail stores, supermarkets, suppliers, and delivery partners to ensure smooth operations.
Monitor product freshness, quality standards, stock availability, and delivery accuracy.
Assist with inventory management, order tracking, and replenishment planning.
Handle store inquiries, delivery issues, customer feedback, and operational requests.
Support logistics planning, route coordination, and delivery performance monitoring.
Maintain accurate delivery records, stock reports, and operational documentation.
Identify opportunities to improve delivery efficiency, reduce product wastage, and enhance service quality.
Build positive working relationships with store managers and supply chain partners.
Diploma or Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, Food Management, or a related discipline.
Experience in food distribution, retail operations, logistics, or customer service is an advantage.
Basic understanding of inventory control, delivery coordination, and fresh food handling procedures.
Good communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to liaise with different stakeholders.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities.
Basic computer skills, including Microsoft Office and inventory management systems.
Willingness to learn, take initiative, and work in a fast-paced operational environment.
Flexibility to support delivery schedules and store operations when required.

Outbound: Efficient and accurate picking and packing of customer orders, as per SOP
Constantly monitor fulfillment processes and recommend improvements to increase productivity and profits.
To supervise assigned store, ensure profitability, provide good service and ensure development of employees
Managing store personnel ensuring effective use of resources and meeting service level standards
Monitoring, managing and controlling costs against the budget, maximizing cost effectiveness of stores operations
Ensuring implementation of actions pertinent to store-related shrinkages
Ensuring that equipment, infrastructure, etc. in stores are used properly and, at all times, maintained in good condition

Supervising the effective implementation of hygiene, sanitation, security and safety standards, as well as service level standards and ensuring a high level customer service both internally and externally
Discussing with the Ops manager stores' issues/problems and propose solutions
Supervise all the maintenance internal activities and / third party suppliers.
Ensuring appropriate and safe use of material handling equipment
